description: Project-level Claude Code settings for edopro-retro-formats. The Stop hook captures each session's final reply into a shared .git/agent-inbox/ so Brain and Worker (when both run as Claude Code, in the worktrees described in docs/agents/worktree-mechanism.md) don't rely on the human copy-pasting reports. It only fires for Claude Code sessions -- a Worker round run through a different vendor's tool never writes there, so a missing or stale inbox file means 'unknown', never 'nothing happened'. The push-readiness gate deliberately does NOT live here: it is a real Git pre-push hook (.githooks/pre-push -> scripts/check_push_readiness.py, tested by tests/test_push_readiness.py), because a Claude Code Bash hook both missed ordinary pushes and blocked non-pushes, and never fired at all for a non-Claude Worker. See docs/agents/push-gate.md. The Stop hook uses a shell shim that probes python3, then python, and skips with a clear message if neither is available; the inbox script remains non-blocking.
